changes.description: Fuel level updates while you fly, scoop, or jump.
Merc coin balance is saved with extra ship data.
Buying, switching, transferring, or renaming a ship updates your hangar right away.
Module changes update that module. Jump range, hull, and rebuy update on the next loadout.
Idle status now says Please join a game mode.
A jump or dock updates the current ship's system right away.
Sold ships leave the hangar. A full ship list also drops ships you no longer own.
The local address hint is gone, and FSS signals are no longer shared.
Plot a route in Elite and see it on the EDSpec galaxy map. Jump progress also shows in ED Market Connector, for example Sol (2/5).
Timed unknown signal sources you discover in the FSS scanner can be shared with EDSpec for community stats. Stations and permanent contacts are not included.
Fuel level in the EDMC status bar, plus optional sync for cargo, other ships in your fleet, and module loadouts.
The plugin only sends data while you are in game. If Elite is not running, the status shows PLEASE START GAME.
Your synced route no longer vanishes during hyperspace jumps. After you finish the route, it stays on EDSpec for about 30 seconds before clearing.
Clearer privacy in settings: your commander, system, station, fuel, and docked or on-foot status are always shared while in game. Ship, credits, cargo, fleet, and loadout stay optional.
Fixed EDSpec settings tab not appearing in EDMC settings dialog
Fixed API key entry field compatibility issue (nb.Entry → ttk.Entry)
Improved error handling to ensure settings tab always appears
First release of ED Market Connector plugin
